q: Susanna Wesley yali ani, era lwaki ayitibwa Nnyina w'Obumesodisiti?
a: Susanna Wesley (1669–1742) teyabuulira ku kituuti, teyatandika kkanisa yonna, era teyafulumya kintu kyonna mu bulamu bwe, naye yakuza abantu babiri ku abo abaaleeta ebibala ebisinga obunene mu byafaayo by'Ekikristaayo, John ne Charles Wesley. Okuva mu ffumbiro lye erirabirirwa obulungi ery'ennyumba y'omusumba mu Lincolnshire mwe mwava empisa z'okusaba, "engeri" entegeke, n'okwekebera omuntu ebyandibadde akabonero k'ekibiina ky'Abamesodisiti. Ajjukirwa okusinga si lwa kintu kye yazimba, wabula olw'amaka ge yakola, okuzuukuka okw'ensi yonna mwe kwakulira.

q: Yakulira mu maka ga ngeri ki, era yatuuka atya mu Kkanisa ya Bungereza?
a: Yazaalibwa ng'ayitibwa Susanna Annesley mu London mu 1669, nga ye muto mu baana ba Dr. Samuel Annesley, omuweereza omukulu Omukontanya, ennyumba ye nga kifo ky'okukuŋŋaanira abayivu n'abaweereza. Wadde abawala b'omu mulembe gwe emirundi mingi tebaafuna kuyigirizibwa kwa mutindo, yalina eddembe okusoma ebitabo bya kitaawe era yeeyigiriza yekka eby'okutendekebwamu, eby'amagezi, n'Ebyawandiikibwa. Mu ngeri ey'ekitalo, nga tannaweza myaka kkumi na esatu, yali alowoozezza ekkubo lye okuyita mu mpaka z'ekiseera kye n'eyeerondera Ekkanisa ya Bungereza mu kifo ky'Obutakontanya bwa kitaawe — empisa ey'okukkiriza okukeberebbwa era okweyimirizaawo eyatamuvaako.

q: Obufumbo bwe ne Samuel Wesley bwali butya?
a: Mu 1688 yafumbirwa Samuel Wesley, omusumba omwegombi era omuzibu, era n'atereera naye mu nnyumba y'omusumba ey'e Epworth, gye yamalira obulamu bwe obusigadde. Tebwali bufumbo bwangu: ensimbi bulijjo zaali nnyike, Samuel yasibibwako olw'amabanja, era mu 1701 bombi baagwa mu mpaka enkambwe Susanna, olw'omuntu we ow'omunda, bwe yagaana okugamba "Amiina" ku kusaba kwa bba ku lwa Kabaka William, gwe yali tatwala nga Kabaka wa Bungereza omutuufu. Samuel yaleka amaka okumala ekiseera olw'ekyo, naye ne batabagana, era mutabani waabwe John n'azaalibwa oluvannyuma. Teyawaayo muntu we ow'omunda wadde eri bba gwe yali asaanidde okussaamu ekitiibwa.

q: Yazaala abaana bameka, era yafiirwa bameka?
a: Susanna yazaala abaana kkumi na mwenda mu myaka gye egy'e Epworth, mwenda ku bo ne bafiira mu buto, nga mwe muli emirundi ebiri egy'abalongo, era omu yattibwa mu butanwa omulezi eyali akooye. Kkumi baawangaala okutuuka mu bukulu, nga mwe muli John ne Charles Wesley. Teyakweka buzito obwo obw'abaana abaziikibwa mabega w'okutya Katonda; yanakuwala mu lwatu, era ne yeeyiwa mu abo abaasigalawo.

q: Kiki ekyaliwo mu muliro gw'ennyumba y'omusumba ey'e Epworth mu 1709?
a: Ekiro ekimu mu Febwali 1709 ennyumba y'omusumba yakwatibwa omuliro, era ab'omu nnyumba ne badduka mu kizikiza ne balyoka bategeera nti John ow'emyaka etaano yali akyasibiddwa ku ddirisa erya waggulu. Baliraanwa baakola eddaala ery'abantu ne bamuggyayo nga bukyaliwo obuseera obutono ng'akasolya tekannagwa. Susanna yaddizibwa mutabani we ng'oyo eyazuukizibwa mu bafu, era John yeeyogerako nga "ekitawuliro ekyaggyibwa mu muliro" obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo. Mu mpapula ze ez'ekyama nnyina yamalirira okwegendereza "mu ngeri ey'enjawulo omwoyo gw'omwana ono" Katonda gwe yali ateekeddeteekedde n'ekisa ekingi bwe kityo.

q: Yayigiriza atya abaana be, era engeri ye yakola etya Obumesodisiti?
a: Susanna yamalirira okuyigiriza buli mwana ye kennyini n'empisa eyafuuka ey'ettutumu: essomero lyatandikanga ku lunaku olw'okuzaalibwa olw'okutuukiriza emyaka etaano, ennukuta zaayigibwanga mu lunaku lumu, era buli lunaku lwaggulwanga ne luggalwa n'okusoma Zabbuli n'Ebyawandiikibwa. Yanywerera nti omulimu ogusooka ogw'omuzadde Omukristaayo gwali kuwangula okwagala kw'omwana kwe yekka amagezi n'eddiini bisobole okusimba emirandira, ng'awandiika nti "okuwangula okwagala kintu ekiteekwa okukolebwa omulundi gumu." John bwe yamusaba oluvannyuma awandiike engeri ye, ebbaluwa gye yamuweereza mu 1732 yafuuka ekiwandiiko ekiterekebwa eky'okukuza abaana mu Kikristaayo, era enkuŋŋaana z'ebibinja, okwewaayo okutegeke, n'"engeri" y'ekibiina batabani be kye baazimba byetikka obubonero bwakyo obweyoleka.

q: Ddala yawanga buli mwana okufaayo kwe ku bubwe wadde nga amaka gaali manene bwe gatyo?
a: Yee. Mu kunyiga kw'ennyumba ejjudde abaana, yayawulanga akawungeezi akakwata buli wiiki okubeera yekka ne buli mwana mu kyanjukiro, okwogera nabo kinnoomu ku mbeera y'emyoyo gyabwe. Emabega w'ekyo waaliwo okukkiriza kwe nti kimugwanira "okutunuulira buli mwoyo gw'oleka wansi w'obulabirizi bwange nga talanta eyanteresebwa Mukama omukulu." Yayolekanya obukambwe bwe n'obukwatampola obw'ekitalo obw'okussaayo omwoyo ku buli muntu.

q: Kya mazima nti yakulembera okusinza mu ffumbiro okwasikiriza abantu okusinga omusumba omuyambi ow'ekitundu?
a: Yee. Mu kiseera bba yali agenze ekiseera ekiwanvu, Susanna yatandika okusinza okwa Ssande akawungeezi mu ffumbiro ery'ennyumba y'omusumba ku lw'abaana be, ng'asoma ekibuulwa n'ayimba Zabbuli; abaddu ne basaba okujja, oluvannyuma baliraanwa, okutuusa enkuŋŋaana lwe zaafuuka abantu nga bibiri, okusinga abajjuza ekkanisa y'ekitundu. Samuel bwe yagaana nti tekyali kya kifaananyi kirungi eri omukazi, yamuddamu nti yali tasobola olw'omuntu we ow'omunda okuleka ekirungi ekyeyoleka bwe kityo, era nti bwe yali ddala ayagala kikome ng'alina okumulagira mu bujjuvu n'avunaanibwa ku lwakyo mu maaso ga Katonda. Teyakikola, era mu mulembe ogwataali guwa bakazi kituuti, awatali kukigenderera n'afuuka ng'omubuulizi w'ekika mu kyalo kye.

Eri Susanna, okusaba tekwali kiddukiro kya luusi luusi wabula empisa eyategeka buli kintu ekirala, era mu bujulizi bwe yennyini yayawulanga ng'essaawa bbiri eza buli lunaku olw'okusaba okw'ekyama. Ng'atasobola kufuna kisenge kya kasirise mu nnyumba ejjudde bwe etyo, yasitulanga ekitambaala kye ekiwanvu ku mutwe gwe, era buli mwana yamanya nti Maama bwe yabeeranga wansi w'ekitambaala kye yabeeranga ne Katonda era teyandinyeenyezeddwa okuggyako mu bwetaavu obusinga obunene. Wansi w'eweema eyo ey'engoye z'awaka yasomanga Bayibuli ye, ng'akebera omuntu we, era ng'asabira amaka ge erinnya ku rinnya.

q: Susanna Wesley yafa atya, era ebigambo bye eby'enkomerero byali biruwa?
a: Samuel bwe yafa mu 1735, yaleka Epworth n'agenda mu London, gye yamalira emyaka gye egy'enkomerero okumpi n'abaana be, ng'atunuulira entandikwa ez'olubereberye ez'okuzuukuka batabani be kwe baali bakulembera. Yafa nga 23 Julaayi 1742, ng'aweza emyaka nsanvu mu esatu, ng'abaana be abakulu bangi bakuŋŋaanidde ku kitanda kye. Nga okwogera kwe tekunnalema yabawa ekiragiro eky'oluvannyuma ekyakuŋŋaanya obulamu bwe bwonna: "Baana bange, amangu nga mpeddwa eddembe, muyimbire Katonda Zabbuli ey'ettendo." John, eyabuulira ku kuziika kwe mu Bunhill Fields, yawandiika nti "awatali kulwana kwonna, wadde kabonero, wadde kusinda, omwoyo gwateebwa eddembe."
